claim_summaries: A three-parameter family of compact PSL(2,R) left-invariant flows exactly saturates W >= 4 nu Vol H^2 for every a>0, v>0, beta!=0, conditional only on the smooth-measure Pesin entropy formula.
Constant-curvature geodesic flows on closed genus-g surfaces give exact non-Sol examples with H=kappa and W=32 pi^2 nu (g-1), independent of curvature scale.

Exact rational algebra plus outward rational intervals certify the finite examples; independently rounded measurements cannot certify the zero-margin equality without preserving the shared exact parameters.
